overview.title: Social media services for businesses
overview.intro: From strategy and filming to day-to-day management: we take on the tasks there is rarely time for in a busy business. Book individual building blocks or hand over your channels completely.
overview.agencyTitle: What does a social media agency do?
agencyText: A social media agency plans, produces and publishes content for a business’s channels and looks after the dialogue with its community. That includes a strategy with clear goals, a content calendar, photos and videos, copy, publishing, replying to comments and messages, and regular reporting.
At Social Media Komplett, on-site production comes on top: we film and photograph right in your business instead of relying on interchangeable stock material.
overview.compareIntro: Both are possible. This overview helps you decide.

meta.title: Social Media Management for Businesses in Münster & NRW
meta.description: Social media management from Social Media Komplett: planning, content, publishing, community and reporting for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok – in one place.

social-media-management.name: Social Media Management
social-media-management.short: Planning, publishing and ongoing management of your channels – reliably, week after week.
social-media-management.title: Social media management: your channels, fully taken care of
social-media-management.intro: We take on the ongoing work on your social media channels – from monthly planning to the published post. You stay in control of the content without having to worry about getting it done.
social-media-management.definition: Social media management covers all the recurring tasks around a business’s social media channels: planning topics, creating content, publishing posts, responding to comments and messages, and evaluating the results. The aim is a regular, consistent presence that fits the business’s goals.

includes.title: Content calendar
includes.text: A monthly plan with topics, formats and dates that you see and approve in advance.

includes.title: Content creation
includes.text: Photos, graphics, Reels and copy, tailored to your brand and your target audience.

includes.title: Publishing
includes.text: We schedule and publish posts, Reels and Stories at sensible times.

includes.title: Profile maintenance
includes.text: Bio, highlights, links and contact options stay up to date and easy to navigate.

includes.title: Community
includes.text: On request, we reply to comments and messages according to agreed guidelines.

includes.title: Reporting
includes.text: A regular, easy-to-understand report with the key figures and specific next steps.

howItWorks.title: Getting to know you and your goals
howItWorks.text: We clarify who you want to reach and how you want to measure success – for example table reservations, appointment enquiries or job applications.

howItWorks.title: Plan and production
howItWorks.text: The content calendar is turned into content, much of it at a shoot in your business.

howItWorks.title: Approval and publishing
howItWorks.text: You check the posts in advance. Once you have approved them, they go live as scheduled.

howItWorks.title: Evaluate and adjust
howItWorks.text: We look at the figures regularly and adjust topics and formats.

forWhom: Owners who have so far handled social media on the side
Businesses whose channels are only updated irregularly
Businesses that want one fixed point of contact instead of a patchwork of one-off solutions

faq.q: Is it worth outsourcing Instagram management?
faq.a: It is worthwhile above all when your business lacks the time or the know-how for regular, well-made content. You gain time and a reliable presence. If you enjoy posting yourself and only need help now and then, an individual service such as a shoot or a strategy may be the better choice.

faq.q: Which platforms do you manage?
faq.a: Our focus is on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. Which channels make sense for you is something we work out together in the strategy – not every business has to be everywhere.

faq.q: Do I keep access to my accounts?
faq.a: Yes. The accounts belong to you and remain yours. We work with the access rights you grant us, and you can withdraw them at any time.

faq.q: How much does social media management cost?
faq.a: The price depends on the scope: the number of channels, posts and Reels per month, on-site shoots and community management. After the initial consultation you will receive a specific quote.

meta.title: Content Creation for Social Media – Photos, Graphics, Copy
meta.description: Professional content creation for businesses in Münster and NRW: photos, graphics, carousels and copy – produced on site in your business on request.

content-creation.name: Content Creation
content-creation.short: Photos, graphics and copy that fit your brand – produced in your business.
content-creation.title: Content creation: content that looks like you
content-creation.intro: We produce photos, graphics, carousels and copy for your channels. The shots are taken on site at your premises, so your presence feels genuine and stands out from interchangeable stock images.
content-creation.definition: Content creation is the planning and production of the content a business publishes on social media – that is, photos, videos, graphics and copy. Good content answers the target audience’s questions, shows what the business offers and makes it recognisable.

includes.title: Topics and ideas
includes.text: A list of topics based on what you offer, the questions your customers ask and the season.

includes.title: On-site photos
includes.text: Products, premises, team and processes – photographed in your business.

includes.title: Graphics and carousels
includes.text: Templates in your colours and fonts for offers, tips and announcements.

includes.title: Copy and hashtags
includes.text: Captions that are easy to understand and invite people to take action.

includes.title: Formats for every platform
includes.text: Crops for feed, Story and cover images, so everything is displayed cleanly.

includes.title: Organised handover
includes.text: You receive the content clearly sorted – for approval or to publish yourself.

howItWorks.title: Briefing
howItWorks.text: We collect what should be shown: offers, special features, people, dates.

howItWorks.title: Production
howItWorks.text: Photos and videos are created at a shoot, graphics and copy afterwards.

howItWorks.title: Review
howItWorks.text: You see the content and can note any changes before anything is published.

forWhom: Businesses that post themselves but need better content
Businesses with an offering that has to be seen – food, haircuts, premises, products
Teams that lack templates and a consistent look

faq.q: Can a social media agency come to my business?
faq.a: Yes, that is exactly our approach. We come to your business for photo and video shoots. We offer on-site shoots around Münster and in large parts of NRW, depending on the driving distance and individual arrangement.

faq.q: Who owns the content that is created?
faq.a: We set out the usage rights transparently in the quote. The usual arrangement is that you can use the content permanently for your own channels and your website.

faq.q: Do my employees have to appear on camera?
faq.a: No. People make a presence more personal, but nobody has to be filmed. We only show people who have expressly agreed to it.

meta.title: Reels Production Münster – Videos for Instagram & TikTok
meta.description: On-site Reels and video production: concept, filming, editing, subtitles and cover image for Instagram, TikTok and Facebook – in Münster and, by arrangement, in NRW.

reels-video-production.name: Reels & Video Production
reels-video-production.short: Concept, filming and editing for Reels and short videos – right on your premises.
reels-video-production.title: Reels & video production: short videos that show your business
reels-video-production.intro: Short videos are the format that lets businesses on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook reach people who don’t follow them yet. We take care of the idea, filming and editing – you need neither equipment nor experience in front of the camera.
reels-video-production.definitionTitle: How does professional Reels production work?
reels-video-production.definition: Professional Reels production consists of four steps: a concept with a topic and an opening, the on-site shoot, editing with subtitles and sound, and publishing with a cover image and caption. A well-prepared shoot usually yields several videos, which are published over a number of weeks.

includes.title: Concept and script
includes.text: For each video we define the topic, opening and sequence – short and easy to follow.

includes.title: On-site shoot
includes.text: We film in your business with suitable camera, lighting and sound equipment.

includes.title: Editing
includes.text: Dynamic editing in portrait format, tailored to the platform in question.

includes.title: Subtitles and cover image
includes.text: Subtitles for watching without sound and a cover image that fits your profile.

includes.title: Music and sound
includes.text: We make sure that the music used is cleared for use by business accounts.

includes.title: Publishing
includes.text: On request, we put the videos online for you with a caption and hashtags.

howItWorks.title: Collecting ideas
howItWorks.text: Together we decide what will be shown: processes, products, people, answers to frequently asked questions.

howItWorks.title: Shoot date
howItWorks.text: We film several videos in one session so that your business is disrupted as little as possible.

howItWorks.title: Editing and approval
howItWorks.text: You receive the finished videos to view and either approve them or tell us what you would like changed.

howItWorks.title: Publish and learn
howItWorks.text: After publishing, we look at which videos go down well and plan the next ones on that basis.

forWhom: Restaurants, cafés and bars that want to show their atmosphere and dishes
Salons and studios where the result is visible
Local businesses that want to reach new customers in their area

faq.q: How long does a shoot take?
faq.a: That depends on the number of videos. For several Reels we usually plan a few hours. We agree the schedule in advance so that it fits your business.

faq.q: Do I have to be in front of the camera myself?
faq.a: No. Many good Reels show processes, details and results. If you or your team are happy to be seen, we guide you through it – that often comes across as particularly approachable.

faq.q: Can I book Reels without ongoing management?
faq.a: Yes. Reels production can be booked as an individual service, for example as a package consisting of one shoot and several finished videos.

meta.title: Social Media Strategy for Small and Local Businesses
meta.description: Social media strategy from Social Media Komplett: goals, audience, channels, topics and key figures – a clear plan to implement yourself or hand over to us.

social-media-strategy.name: Social Media Strategy
social-media-strategy.short: Goals, target audience, channels and topics – a clear plan instead of posting by gut feeling.
social-media-strategy.title: Social media strategy: a plan that fits your business
social-media-strategy.intro: Without a plan, social media quickly turns into a never-ending building site. We develop a strategy with you that defines who you want to reach, on which channels and with what content – and how you can tell whether it is working.
social-media-strategy.definitionTitle: What belongs in a social media strategy?
social-media-strategy.definition: A social media strategy for a small business answers five questions: What should social media achieve for the business? Who should it speak to? Which channels make sense for that? Which topics and formats will be published regularly? And which key figures will be used to check success?

includes.title: Stocktake
includes.text: We look at your existing channels, content and results.

includes.title: Goals and target audience
includes.text: Specific, verifiable goals and a clear picture of the people you want to reach.

includes.title: Channel selection
includes.text: A reasoned recommendation as to which platforms are worth your while – and which are not.

includes.title: Topics and formats
includes.text: Recurring content series that fit what you offer and are easy to produce.

includes.title: Posting rhythm
includes.text: A realistic plan for how often and when to publish.

includes.title: Key figures
includes.text: A few meaningful metrics and a simple routine for the monthly review.

howItWorks.title: Conversation
howItWorks.text: In an in-depth meeting we get to know your business, your customers and your goals.

howItWorks.title: Development
howItWorks.text: We summarise the strategy in a clearly structured document.

howItWorks.title: Handover
howItWorks.text: We go through the plan together. You implement it yourself or hand the implementation over to us.

forWhom: Businesses that are just starting out on social media
Businesses that post a lot but see little effect
Teams that handle social media in-house and need a common thread

faq.q: Do I really need a strategy as a small business?
faq.a: Yes, but it doesn’t have to be extensive. Even a few clear decisions on goals, target audience, topics and rhythm stop you putting time into content that achieves nothing.

faq.q: Which platforms should my business be active on?
faq.a: Wherever your customers actually spend their time and wherever you can deliver good content regularly. One well-maintained channel is generally more effective than three half-hearted ones.

faq.q: Will I get the strategy in writing?
faq.a: Yes. You receive a document that you or your team can keep working with, even without us.

meta.title: Community Management – Handling Comments & Messages
meta.description: Community management for businesses: we reply to comments and messages according to agreed guidelines and reliably pass enquiries on to you.

community-management.name: Community Management
community-management.short: Comments and messages are answered promptly and in your brand’s tone of voice.
community-management.title: Community management: nobody is left without a reply
community-management.intro: On social media, people ask questions, make reservations, give praise and criticise. Those who reply quickly and in a friendly way earn trust. We take on this communication according to guidelines we agree with you beforehand.
community-management.definition: Community management means looking after the communication on a business’s social media channels. It includes replying to comments and direct messages, passing on enquiries, responding to criticism in a factual way and moderating unwanted content such as spam.

includes.title: Replying to comments
includes.text: We respond to comments under your posts – friendly and in your tone of voice.

includes.title: Handling messages
includes.text: We answer frequently asked questions directly and pass everything else on to you.

includes.title: Response guide
includes.text: Together we define how to respond to typical questions, praise and criticism.

includes.title: Moderation
includes.text: Spam and abusive content is hidden or reported according to clear rules.

includes.title: Passing on important enquiries
includes.text: Reservations, appointment requests and complaints reach you via the agreed channel.

includes.title: Feedback from the community
includes.text: Recurring questions and requests feed into content planning.

howItWorks.title: Defining guidelines
howItWorks.text: Tone of voice, response times, responsibilities and limits are clarified in advance.

howItWorks.title: Ongoing management
howItWorks.text: We check comments and messages at the agreed times.

howItWorks.title: Regular catch-ups
howItWorks.text: We discuss anything unusual and any frequent questions with you and adjust the guidelines.

forWhom: Businesses that receive many enquiries via Instagram or Facebook
Businesses where messages go unanswered in the daily rush
Brands that want to come across as professional even when criticised

faq.q: Do you reply in my name?
faq.a: We reply on behalf of your business and in line with the agreed guide. Questions that only you can answer – for example about individual prices or complaints – are passed on to you.

faq.q: How quickly are replies sent?
faq.a: We define the response times together and record them in the quote. Round-the-clock cover is not standard, but can be discussed.

faq.q: How do you deal with negative criticism?
faq.a: Factually and with a focus on solutions. We answer justified criticism openly and pass it on to you; abusive content or spam is moderated. We agree sensitive cases with you before replying.

meta.title: Menu Design & Redesign for Restaurants
meta.description: Have your menu designed or redesigned: printed menus, PDF and QR code menus, takeaway and seasonal menus – print-ready, for hospitality in Münster & NRW.

menu-design.name: Menu design
menu-design.short: New menus and redesigns – printed, as a PDF and as a QR code menu.
menu-design.title: Menu design & redesign: a menu that suits your kitchen
menu-design.intro: The menu is the one document every guest picks up. We design new menus and modernise existing ones – clearly laid out, easy to read and in keeping with your business. For restaurants, cafés, food trucks, snack bars and delivery businesses.
menu-design.definitionTitle: What does professional menu design involve?
menu-design.definition: Professional menu design arranges what you offer so that guests find their way around quickly: with a clear structure, a legible typeface, colours that work together and – where it fits – photos of the dishes. The result is finished files for printing, plus digital versions as a PDF or QR code menu.

includes.title: New menus
includes.text: Complete design, from the structure to the finished layout.

includes.title: Redesign of existing menus
includes.text: We modernise your existing menu without changing what you offer.

includes.title: Typography, colours and layout
includes.text: Typefaces, colours and a grid that suit your business and are easy to read.

includes.title: Printed menus
includes.text: Formats for table menus, clipboards, table stands or boards – matched to how you use them.

includes.title: PDF and digital menus
includes.text: A version for your website, social media and for sending out.

includes.title: QR code menus
includes.text: QR codes that lead to a hosted menu page or a file.

includes.title: Takeaway and delivery menus
includes.text: Compact flyers and menus for collection and delivery.

includes.title: Promotional and seasonal menus
includes.text: Inserts for lunch offers, the season, public holidays and events in the same style.

includes.title: Print-ready files
includes.text: Print files to your printer’s specifications – on request, we coordinate with them directly.

includes.title: Multilingual menus
includes.text: On request, we typeset your menu in further languages. You supply the translations, or we work them out together.

howItWorks.title: Taking stock
howItWorks.text: You send us your current menu, dishes, prices and mandatory information. We clarify format, scope and style.

howItWorks.title: Draft
howItWorks.text: You receive a design draft with structure, typefaces and colours – with photos from a shoot, if you like.

howItWorks.title: Corrections and approval
howItWorks.text: You check the content, prices and allergen information and approve the menu. Nothing goes to print without your approval.

howItWorks.title: Handover
howItWorks.text: You receive print files, a PDF and – if required – a QR code and templates for inserts.

forWhom: Restaurants, cafés and bars with a menu that has grown over the years
Food trucks, snack bars and delivery businesses that need a compact menu
Newly opened businesses that want a consistent look from the start

faq.q: Where do the copy, prices and allergen information come from?
faq.a: From you. We do the design, but we do not set prices and we do not change any information on allergens or additives. You check all content before printing and approve it. Which mandatory information applies to your business is best clarified with your chamber, your trade association or your adviser.

faq.q: Do you print the menus as well?
faq.a: We supply print-ready files. You commission the printing from a printer of your choice; on request, we coordinate the technical specifications with them directly.

faq.q: How does a QR code menu work?
faq.a: The QR code leads to a menu page or a PDF file. Where the menu is hosted and who updates it when prices change is something we agree on together beforehand. We recommend keeping a printed menu available as well.

faq.q: Can you photograph the dishes too?
faq.a: Yes. Food photos can be combined with a shoot for your social media channels or your Google Business Profile – so one appointment produces images for several purposes.

google-business-profile.name: Google Business Profile
google-business-profile.short: Photo refresh & profile maintenance for your presence in Google Search and on Google Maps.
google-business-profile.title: Google Business Profile: photo refresh & profile maintenance
google-business-profile.intro: Anyone searching for your business often sees your Google Business Profile first – with photos, opening hours and contact details. We provide up-to-date, professional images and correct details, so that your business looks the way it really is in Google Search and on Google Maps.
google-business-profile.definitionTitle: What is the Google Business Profile?
google-business-profile.definition: The Google Business Profile (formerly “Google My Business”) is the free listing with which businesses appear in Google Search and on Google Maps. Owners can maintain photos, opening hours, categories, a description and contact details there. Our service is the photography and maintenance work around this profile – the profile itself remains a free Google product.

includes.title: Profile check
includes.text: We look at your profile and note what is missing, out of date or inconsistent.

includes.title: New business photos
includes.text: Professional shots of your business at an on-site appointment.

includes.title: Food photography
includes.text: Dishes and drinks, photographed appetisingly and realistically.

includes.title: Interior and exterior shots
includes.text: Entrance, rooms and atmosphere – so that people recognise and find you.

includes.title: Product and service photos
includes.text: Images of what you offer: products, treatments, finished work.

includes.title: Selection and editing
includes.text: We select the best shots and edit them consistently.

includes.title: Logo and cover photo

includes.title: Checking your details

includes.title: Simple evaluation
includes.text: Where Google provides figures, we summarise views and interactions in an easy-to-understand way.

howItWorks.title: Setting up access
howItWorks.text: You add us as a manager in your profile. You remain the owner – we do not need a password.

howItWorks.title: Profile check
howItWorks.text: We check photos and details and discuss with you what should be updated.

howItWorks.title: On-site photo shoot
howItWorks.text: We photograph your premises, what you offer and – if you wish – your team.

howItWorks.title: Selection and approval
howItWorks.text: You see the edited images and proposed changes and approve them.

howItWorks.title: Upload and maintenance
howItWorks.text: We upload the photos and, on request, take care of updates on a regular basis.

forWhom: Businesses whose profile mainly shows old or random photos
Restaurants, salons, studios and shops that want to be found locally
Businesses after a refurbishment, a move or a new opening, or with a new offering

faq.q: Isn’t the Google Business Profile free?
faq.a: Yes, it is. The profile is a free Google product, and you can maintain it yourself. What you pay us for is the work around it: photography, image editing, checking the details and ongoing maintenance.

faq.q: Can you remove old photos or photos from customers?
faq.a: The business’s own photos can be replaced. Photos uploaded by other people are not something we can simply delete; violations of the guidelines can be reported to Google, and Google decides whether to remove them.

faq.q: Do you decide which photo is shown first?
faq.a: No. We can set a cover photo, but Google itself decides which images appear where. Good, up-to-date photos from the business widen the selection Google can draw on – there is no guarantee.

faq.q: Will this improve my ranking on Google?
faq.a: We do not promise that. We make sure your presentation is complete, up to date and appealing. How Google orders results is not in our hands.

faq.q: Do you need my Google password?
faq.a: No, and we don’t want it either. You add us as a manager and can remove the access at any time. The profile remains yours.

faq.q: Are you a Google partner?
faq.a: No. Social Media Komplett is an independent agency and has no partnership with Google. Google and Google Maps are trademarks of Google LLC.
